methodology.title: Science & Methodology
methodology.heroSubtitle: How VocaFlash helps you learn vocabulary 5x faster than traditional methods.
methodology.curveDesc: Human brains are wired to forget. VocaFlash is designed to prevent that.
methodology.recallCaption: We remind you just as you're about to forget.
methodology.fsrsSubtitle: Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler - The most powerful SRS algorithm generation today.
methodology.stabilityDesc: Represents the number of days you are likely to remember this word with a 90% probability. Higher stability means more durable memory.
methodology.difficultyDesc: Every word has its own complexity. FSRS automatically adjusts based on your feedback to find the optimal learning path.
methodology.retrievabilityDesc: The probability that you can recall the information right now. The system schedules reviews when this drops to a target level.
methodology.repetitionsDesc: Choosing 'Easy', 'Hard', or 'Again' directly impacts the Ease Factor and schedule.
methodology.ratingEasyDesc: Increases Ease Factor. You've mastered this; it will appear less frequently.
methodology.ratingGoodDesc: Correct answer after a bit of thinking. This is the ideal review state.
methodology.ratingHardDesc: Decreases Ease Factor. The algorithm will bring it back sooner.
methodology.ratingAgainDesc: Resets the process to a 1-day interval to build a strong foundation.
methodology.activeRecallDesc: Instead of passive reading, you must retrieve answers. This builds neural snapshots.
methodology.multisensoryDesc: Visuals + Audio + Text activate multiple brain regions simultaneously.
methodology.contextualDesc: Words are anchored in real-world examples for better retention.
methodology.microlearningDesc: 10 minutes a day is key. Small habits lead to big results.
methodology.intensityDesc: Adjust your learning pace in Settings to match your personal style.
methodology.faqQ1: Why aren't there words in Arena immediately after I study?
methodology.faqA1: Newly learned words don't appear immediately. Per Spaced Repetition, brains need a rest interval. The first review typically arrives 24 hours after completion.
methodology.faqA2: Currently, rank reflects your diligence based on your **Daily Goal**. When you complete your target new words, you 'rank up' for the day. Future levels will be based on Total Mastered words.
methodology.faqQ3: Why is my memory stability low but the next review date is far away?
methodology.faqA3:
This is a smart mechanism in FSRS 5 to handle Early Reviews:
1. Early Review Penalty: If you review immediately after learning, your brain hasn't been truly challenged, so Stability won't increase significantly to accurately reflect that the memory is still fresh.
2. Efficiency Priority: Since you chose 'Easy', the system proactively pushes the next review out to avoid bothering you with words you already know well.
3. Advice: Wait until a word is 'Due' before reviewing to maximize your Stability growth rate.
